name: Custom Countdown!
description:
It's a heavily modified and enhanced version of the original GTA VI Countdown by Purple_EyeZ, but now it is 100% customizable so you can use it for absolutely any event you want!

Features & Customization:

    Any Date or Custom Text: Set a target date (YYYY-MM-DD) to count down the days, or simply type a custom word (e.g., "Soon"). 
    Custom Image or GIF: Paste a link to your favorite .png, .jpg, or .gif to display on the left. Don't want an image? Just toggle it off for a sleek text-only look!

    Fully Editable Text: You can change the Main Title, the "Days Left" indicator, and the bottom description.

    Custom Gradient Border: Make it yours by choosing the exact HEX colors for the left and right sides of the outline gradient.

    Bilingual Defaults: Choose between English and French for the default placeholder texts.

    Full Control: Customize the toast duration (1 to 20 seconds) and the frequency (Startup, Hourly, Daily, Weekly).

    Live Preview: Test your setup instantly directly from the settings menu.
